name: trickle-lite
description: See the runtime type of every value in your TypeScript, live, and where it drifts from the declared type.

commands.title: trickle: Connect to Neon (shared runtime types)

trickleLite.hints.enabled.description: Show the observed runtime type of each value inline.

trickleLite.hints.annotated.description: Also show hints where the source already declares a type (drifts are always shown).

trickleLite.project.description: Project name in trickle-lite's Neon database (default: the workspace folder's name).
